demographic.instructions: Which demographic was this anime primarily made for, based on `state`?

criteria.shounen: Teen boys. Action, rivalry, tournaments, power progression.
criteria.shoujo: Teen girls. Romance, emotional relationships, school settings.
criteria.seinen: Adult men. Darker themes, complex plots, graphic violence or psychology.
criteria.josei: Adult women. Realistic romance, workplace, mature relationships.
criteria.kodomomuke: Young children. Simple, episodic, educational or comedic.

primary_genre.instructions: What is the single dominant genre of this anime, based on `state`?

criteria.action: Combat, fights, physical conflict drive the plot.
criteria.adventure: Journey, exploration, quest across a world.
criteria.drama: Emotional conflict and character relationships drive the plot.
criteria.romance: A romantic relationship is the central plot.
criteria.slice_of_life: Everyday life, low stakes, no central conflict.

has_isekai.instructions: Is a character transported to, reborn in, or summoned into another world?

has_mecha.instructions: Are piloted giant robots or powered armor central to the story?

has_romance.instructions: Is there a significant romantic storyline, even if not the main plot?

has_comedy.instructions: Is comedy a significant recurring element?

has_supernatural.instructions: Do supernatural powers, spirits, or magic appear?

has_school.instructions: Is a school or academy a main setting?

is_adaptation.instructions: Is this adapted from a manga, light novel, or video game?

maturity.instructions: How mature is the content of this anime?
criteria: All ages: no violence or suggestive content.
Teen: mild violence, some suggestive humor.
Older teen: serious violence, dark themes.
Adult: graphic violence, explicit sexual content.

palette.instructions: First pick the single most iconic element of this anime — a character or duo, an object, a vehicle, an outfit, a hairstyle, an accessory, a robot, or the defining environment; whichever fans picture first. Then, based on `state`, spread the probability across the colors that element actually is, strongest color first.

criteria.rich_black: Near-absolute black, ink, void, matte darkness.
criteria.charcoal: Dark grey, smoke, stone, overcast gloom.
criteria.gray: Mid grey, concrete, rain, industrial tones.
criteria.silver: Light grey, steel, chrome, metallic sheen.
criteria.chestnut: Dark brown, bark, dried blood, old sepia.
criteria.lime_green: Electric yellow-green, toxic or neon green.
criteria.cyan: Bright cyan, neon, holograms, tech glow.
criteria.sky_blue: Pale blue, daytime sky, open air.
criteria.baby_blue: Very pale soft blue, pastel sky, hazy calm.
criteria.blue: Clear blue, uniforms, water, cool tones.
criteria.navy: Deep blue, night sea, dark uniforms.
criteria.purple: Rich purple, demonic or royal tones.
criteria.royal_purple: Deep regal purple, velvet, imperial robes.
criteria.magenta: Hot pink-purple, neon, idol stage lights.
criteria.baby_pink: Very pale pink, blush, pastel rose.
criteria.maroon: Dark red, dried blood, heavy drama.
criteria.crimson: Deep saturated red, arterial blood, banners.
